business_problem: VUS needed a connected learning platform that could scale for peak usage, speed up feature delivery, cut operating cost, and give teachers immediate visibility into student engagement across a growing digital education ecosystem.
solution_summary: VUS built its connected learning ecosystem on Google Cloud by combining BigQuery, Firebase, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, and Cloud Load Balancing into one modern education platform. BigQuery unifies learner and operational data, while Firebase supports the mobile-first student experience and Vertex AI provides the native AI foundation for future innovation. Cloud Load Balancing and Cloud Run let the platform scale from zero to more than 50,000 concurrent users without delay, and Looker Studio dashboards powered by BigQuery show teachers when student engagement drops so they can intervene early. Cloud Build accelerated release delivery, while Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging reduced support effort. With this stack, VUS turned a fragmented digital estate into a cloud-native learning environment that is faster to ship, cheaper to run, and ready for future AI companions and speech-driven tutoring features.
